eligible_family: continuous late depth-chart role / starting-job security erosion
source: source-season nflverse weekly depth charts; only observations legally available by source-season forecast cutoff
scope_rationale: Stage B matched evidence was consistent/strong for QB and supportive across horizons for WR; RB was near-neutral after Y1 and TE sparse/adverse. The governed Forecast repair concerns future Y2/Y3.

continuous_inputs.absolute_late_role: mean depth_team over final four available source-season weekly depth-chart observations
continuous_inputs.persistent_starting_security: share of final four available observations with depth_team == 1
continuous_inputs.within_season_deterioration: late-half starter share minus early-half starter share

feature_direction.absolute_late_role: higher rank number = greater erosion risk

missing_data: No structural-risk adjustment when the required depth-chart evidence is missing or insufficient; missingness is not pessimistically imputed.
architecture_placement: Adjustment may act only through existing future persistence / active-state / opportunity-state probability machinery. It may not directly suppress conditional-production magnitude.
estimation: Estimate permitted coefficients only inside the existing legal chronological Forecast training framework, with training-fold-only standardization and existing governed regularization/bounds. No named-player calibration, current-board tuning, threshold search, broad hyperparameter search, or target-period information.
excluded_families: persistent physical-risk label without causal source
explicit successor narrative as separate feature

candidate_definitions.S1: B2a conditional-production architecture unchanged + frozen Stage-C role/security adjustment to existing future persistence/state/opportunity machinery
candidate_definitions.S2: Only permissible if an already-developed richer conditional-production component can be paired with this exact frozen Stage-C machinery without any new model-family/feature/tuning choice

evaluation_freeze: Pre-holdout chronological evidence only for candidate selection. Untouched holdout and preserved current board remain sealed until a candidate and pre-holdout conclusion are frozen.
